issues.problem: The rate limit is published, so "not published" is incorrect.
issues.suggestion: Use "150 requests per 10 seconds; exceeding it returns HTTP 429 and triggers a 60-second timeout."

issues.problem: The example reports dailyQuota as 50, contradicting the current Free-plan limit of 10 requests per day stated elsewhere in the entry.
issues.suggestion: Use dailyQuota: 10 for a Free-plan example, or make clear that the response came from a different plan.

issues.problem: The listed Starter and Team plan names are stale. Current Chat pricing uses Build, Start, Elevate, and Enterprise; Maker is a separate eligibility-based offer.
issues.suggestion: Replace with "Build (free), Start, Elevate, and Enterprise; qualifying small teams may obtain a Maker account."

issues.problem: Stream publishes detailed rate limits, so "not published" is incorrect.
issues.suggestion: Describe the per-endpoint, per-platform one-minute limits; for example, Query Channels is normally 10,000/minute, Send Message 1,000/minute, and a 60/minute per-user limit also applies. Limits can be dynamically adjusted.

issues.problem: The stated limits incorrectly separate reads and writes and incorrectly say test mode is higher. Stripe's global basic limit is 100 operations/second in live mode and 25 operations/second in sandbox, with a default 25/second endpoint limit and endpoint-specific exceptions.
issues.suggestion: Use "Global limit: 100 operations/sec in live mode and 25 operations/sec in sandbox; endpoints normally have a 25 operations/sec default, with documented exceptions."

issues.problem: Direct backend REST calls use HTTP Basic authentication with project_id and secret; the claimed alternative "API key headers" is not part of the documented direct REST authentication interface.
issues.suggestion: Use "Project ID and secret via HTTP Basic Auth. Frontend SDKs use the environment's public token instead."

issues.problem: The request targets the live api.stytch.com environment, but the example response uses test-environment identifiers such as request-id-test and user-test. A live request returns live-environment IDs.
issues.suggestion: Either change the request to https://test.stytch.com/v1/magic_links/email/login_or_create or change the response placeholders to live-environment identifiers.

issues.problem: TaxJar publishes its API limits, so "not published" is incorrect.
issues.suggestion: Use "10,000 requests per minute for Professional plans and 25,000 requests per minute for Premium plans; excess traffic can receive HTTP 429."
